pairs.why: The two zip bags look almost the same in finish, construction and lighting, so neither is clearly closer to the real cards.

B's blue is a little brighter and more saturated, with softer, lighter edges, which is closer to the cheerful vending machine and phone booth; A is slightly darker and heavier.
